title: Delegated grant revoked while reservation is pending
description: Parent revokes child A's budget authority after a reservation request is initiated but before it is committed.
expected_invariants: The system defines whether pending reservation requests are rejected, honored, or reconciled after revocation; the result must not be ambiguous.
failure_mode: Revoked child receives new usable capacity without a documented revocation race policy.
notes: Revocation ordering and in-flight policy require reviewer attention.
